Making the book cover fully visible does not alter any landing-page mechanics copy.

The About page content is independent of the landing-page book-cover visibility adjustment.
The source does not change the Mission page or any of its approved content.
The book-cover visibility adjustment does not change the current or planned product name.
The source does not change public prize-pool values, APIs, or the next-draw counter.
The landing-page visual issue has no effect on the Mauritius access restriction.
The source concerns presentation of the ebook cover, not badge catalog or badge icon presentation.
The source does not alter winner announcement or notification channels.
The requirement that the landing-page cover image be fully visible does not change NFT metadata fields or counters.
The book-cover display adjustment does not affect ticket counters, resets, or dashboard ticket accounting.
